extracted.intended_audience: authors, contributors, peer reviewers, and editors involved in medical journal publishing
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for completing and submitting the ICMJE Disclosure of Interest form and for handling financial and non-financial conflicts of interest transparently across the lifecycle of a medical manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of Financial and Non-Financial Relationships and Activities, and Conflicts of Interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure of Financial and Non-Financial Relationships and Activities, and Conflicts of Interest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form and recommendations cover both financial and non-financial relationships and activities that could constitute conflicts of interest. (Page headings emphasize that disclosures should include financial and non-financial relationships and activities.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency across the research and publication lifecycle
rubrics_metrics.description: Public trust in the scientific process and the credibility of published articles depend in part on how transparently conflicts of interest are handled during the planning, implementation, writing, peer review, editing, and publication of scientific work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors are expected to disclose relevant interests so that conflicts are transparent at all stages: planning, implementation, manuscript writing, peer review, editorial decision-making, and publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form handling and submission procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Your completed form is NOT to be submitted to the ICMJE and it cannot be saved to the ICMJE website. Save the form on your own computer and check with the journal you are submitting to for specific instructions on how to submit your completed form to them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not upload completed disclosure forms to the ICMJE website. Store a copy locally and follow the target journal's specific instructions for submitting the completed disclosure form to that journal.
